title: Yann Robard - Liquidity Solutions for Private Capital at Dawson (EP.392)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Yann Robard is the founder of Dawson Partners.
reader_summary.overview: Yann Robard is the founder of Dawson Partners, a leading global alternative asset manager overseeing $20 billion that provides innovative structured solutions to the private markets. Formed initially as Whitehorse Liquidity Partners and rebranded as Dawson. Our conversation covers Yann's entrepreneurial career path, including fourteen years in the formative stages of Canadian Pension CPPIB.

key_points.text: Formed initially as Whitehorse Liquidity Partners and rebranded as Dawson.
We discuss the success of the private equity industry, valuations, liquidity, the necessity of scale.
We turn to the process and culture at Dawson and the exciting future of the secondaries market.
